name: Krea2Drift
author: zubzer0
summary: Measures how far an ablation shifts the text conditioning that Krea 2 feeds to its image model, without generating an image.
search: krea2drift zubzer0 measures how far an ablation shifts the text conditioning that krea 2 feeds to its image model, without generating an image. reads the fused text tensor from twelve tapped qwen3-vl layers and reports the mean token cosine drift against the unmodified model, in percent. it is a diagnostic: the shared config uses optimization = none so the score is visible without steering the optimizer. very sensitive to prompt choice, and it needs a krea 2 turbo safetensors checkpoint and roughly 16 gb of vram. scorer community scorer krea2 qwen3-vl image diagnostic

name: Krea2Good
author: zubzer0
summary: Minimizes the p90 drift of good image prompts so an ablation leaves benign Krea 2 conditioning stable.
search: krea2good zubzer0 minimizes the p90 drift of good image prompts so an ablation leaves benign krea 2 conditioning stable. the first half of a paired scorer for image-generating vlms. it takes the largest conditioning drift left after discarding the ten percent of prompts that moved most, then asks the optimizer to minimize it. lower values mean the good prompts kept their original trajectory. use it together with krea2bad and a kl divergence scorer. scorer community scorer krea2 qwen3-vl image minimize

name: Krea2Bad
author: zubzer0
summary: Maximizes the p90 drift of bad image prompts so abliteration visibly changes how the model handles them.
search: krea2bad zubzer0 maximizes the p90 drift of bad image prompts so abliteration visibly changes how the model handles them. the second half of the paired krea 2 scorer. it keeps the smallest conditioning drift after discarding the ten percent of prompts that moved least, then maximizes it. the author's sign of success is krea2bad p90min rising above krea2good p90max. it correlates with refusal rate on image prompts, so it is useful only alongside a quality scorer such as kl divergence. scorer community scorer krea2 qwen3-vl image maximize

name: GibberishRate
author: randomlygeneratedusername
summary: Flags trials whose responses turn into gibberish by counting distinct Unicode scripts.
search: gibberishrate randomlygeneratedusername flags trials whose responses turn into gibberish by counting distinct unicode scripts. a community scorer written with coding-model assistance after ara runs produced incoherent outputs. it probes a few prompts per trial and classifies a response as gibberish when it contains more than a configured number of distinct scripts. by default it skips or aborts affected trials rather than adding another optimization objective. no source repository was published; only the config snippet is available. scorer proof-of-concept scorer gibberish unicode ara guardrail

name: Calibrated PIQA
author: electroglyph
summary: A fork of Heretic with a benchmark scorer tuned to PIQA questions that flip between right and wrong.
search: calibrated piqa electroglyph a fork of heretic with a benchmark scorer tuned to piqa questions that flip between right and wrong. built on the mainline benchmarkscore idea, this fork repeatedly evaluates a model, keeps questions whose answers flip-flop, and batches those questions to get a higher-signal quality metric. it was used while comparing ablated models against gpqa results. the author reports a modest improvement in signal over plain piqa, not a perfect correlation. scorer community scorer benchmark piqa gpqa fork
